biggest_catch: No expiry or full footnote disclosures are stated on the official landing page, so the offer could be withdrawn at any time; qualify fast and keep both accounts in Member Advantage status for 120 days.
catches: New BECU members only; must be within BECU's field of membership (ID, OR, WA, SC per availability).
Must open both a Member Share or Member Advantage Savings account AND a Checking account with promo code BECU4YOU.
Must complete 10 or more qualifying transactions within the first 30 days (debit/credit purchases, checks, deposits/withdrawals).
Bonus deposited within 120 days of account opening; accounts must remain open with Member Advantage status to receive it.
No explicit expiry date on the official page - offer may be changed or withdrawn without notice.
Tied to the 2026 Washington State Fair partnership campaign; may not persist after the event.
No monthly fee on checking/savings; low fees and competitive rates advertised.

steps: Join BECU online or at a branch, opening both a Member Share or Member Advantage Savings account and a Checking account, entering promo code BECU4YOU.
Within the first 30 days, perform 10 or more qualifying transactions: debit/credit card purchases, paper or electronic checks, or deposits/withdrawals via the checking account.
Keep both accounts open with Member Advantage status.
Receive the $150 bonus deposit within 120 days of account opening.
timing: Bonus deposited within 120 days of account opening. No expiry date stated on the official page.

maximize: Fastest honest path. No direct deposit needed, so qualification can be same-day.
